entries.title: Your first mate answers while a task starts
entries.body: When your first mate starts a task or sends a crewmate a message, it answers as soon as the request is saved, instead of waiting a minute or more for the crewmate to start. The tile shows Starting, then any wait. A task that cannot start, a review included, stays on your board saying why and keeps its working copy for the next try. A message is saved on its task when sent, so quitting while its files are handed over loses nothing. If a start or a hand-over fails, your first mate hears about it and tells you.
entries.noPicture: The views are the ones a task that could not start already shows; what changes is how soon the first mate's reply arrives and that the task stays.
